hints.title: Greedy Minimum Cost Choice
hints.text: Buying the cheapest ice cream bars first always maximizes the total number of bars that can be purchased.

hints.title: Sort by Cost
hints.text: Sort the cost array in non-decreasing order to inspect cheapest items first.

hints.title: Iterative Purchase Deduction
hints.text: Iterate through sorted costs, subtracting each price from coins until coins are insufficient.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is number of ice cream bars
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Choosing expensive bars early limits the remaining count of affordable bars.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the costs allows a greedy linear scan to purchase the maximum number of bars.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts costs and consumes coins greedily from cheapest to most expensive.
